data.exact_reserve_text: This has resulted in an explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation. Nevertheless, net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit (Prior: n/a) for the year.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1254 executed an inwards RITC (Syndicate 2689 2017-2019) adding GBP 75.243m of gross liabilities at 1 January 2022. Over calendar year 2022 the gross provision for claims reduced by GBP 27.481m (release), producing net reserve releases that contributed GBP 4.7m to the year's profit. The movement reflects favourable claims development on the transferred legacy portfolio, although management has applied an explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation.
raw_causal_phrases: explicit uplift to reserves to allow for anticipated claims inflation
net reserve releases contributed a GBP 4.7m profit (Prior: n/a) for the year
Reserve releases in excess of claim payments will generate profits for the Syndicate and vice versa

data.data_quality_notes: This is the Syndicate's first year of account and opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2022 was nil prior to the inwards RITC. The prior year development figure (-27.481m) is taken from the 'Change in the provision for claims in the year' in the technical reserves movement table; this movement largely relates to the transferred 2017-2019 years. No gross per-line prior-year reserve movements are provided, and no claims development triangle is present. Net figures are reported elsewhere in the accounts (e.g. net reserve release GBP 4.7m) but the prior_year_development_gbp_m above is the gross movement as stated in the technical reserves note.
